The '''ancient access tunnel''' was a tunnel carved through the ice wall separating the [[Power Center cavern]] and the [[Outer Depths]], two sections of the [[Ancient Prison Caverns]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. It was built by the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] [[Species/Legends|species]] along with the rest of the structures in the caverns and [[the Tomb]].<ref name="TOR" />
